scope: Same source BVH bytes, all original 1165 frames, same robot and solver cohort settings; generic neutral vs fitted uniform SOMA representation. Descriptive experiment, not causal ranking or dynamic feasibility.

robot_consistency.scope: Exact compiled selected arrays, names/order, static sampled robot surface and official settings; not whole simulator equivalence

spatial_segment_consistency.definition: Identical 4096 robot reference samples; assign nearest projected binding label independently in each cohort. Learned slot indices are never equated across training runs.

definitions.centroids: Mean of bound surface slots per native19 label; decoded source is already scaled by saved source_scale. Subtract each own hips surface centroid; retain all rotations. Aggregate excludes the trivially zero anchored hips region, with equal weight per remaining segment and frame. Both retained inspectors use the corrected moving named Hips anchor for mesh encoding; this diagnostic separately uses the hips surface centroid. Different proportions/reference poses and slot locations contribute to mismatch; this is not a correspondence accuracy score.
definitions.foot_proxy: Y-up floor y=0; per-frame fifth percentile of reconstructed bound foot-slot heights. Near floor means both adjacent heights <= 0.02 m. Speed uses foot segment centroid in horizontal x/z, at recorded FPS. Geometry/sample proxy, not contact labels or measured support forces.
definitions.directions: World-frame angle between corresponding source and robot vectors joining named segment surface centroids. Retains orientation; ignores vector length. Surface region placement and embodiment proportions affect this descriptive metric.
definitions.joint_step: Absolute adjacent scalar qpos differences, without wrapping or time normalization; clip-specific smoothness diagnostic.

precision_budget.interpretation: Quantization is checked against its own unquantized reference separately. Independent fitted forward calls vary at micrometre scale even in one process, as measured by native-native repeats. No source route, frames or topology are changed.

named_joint_map.coordinates: Y-up metres, saved source scale and source ground shift
named_joint_map.scope: Raw BVH global skeleton and fitted SOMA model transforms share names and local pose channels; fitted shape rest offsets may differ.

fitted_replay_audit.interpretation: BVH hierarchy offsets and fitted model rest offsets are different representations; discrepancies are measured diagnostics, not a failed pose-map assertion. Named Hips anchors the fitted mesh, not stationary Root.
limitations: Visual acceptance remains pending user inspection.
No dynamics, controller rollout, collision evaluation, support-force or contact-truth validation.
Native fitted forward replay checks export fidelity; it does not independently validate the SOMA model implementation.
